name: centricmem-skill
description: Hosted CentricMem librarian: organise and retrieve Markdown memory via host MCP. After install, if cm_* are missing send https://centricmem.com/login?signup=1 and a /connect?device= link; never paste keys in chat.
author: Dr. Z

interface.shortDescription: Hosted librarian for agent memory via host MCP.
interface.longDescription: Organise and retrieve Markdown cards on the hosted CentricMem librarian. Skills plus host MCP at https://mem.centricmem.com/mcp. Set CENTRICMEM_API_KEY to the default key or an extra key (never paste keys in chat). After install, if cm_* are missing send https://centricmem.com/login?signup=1 and a /connect?device= link.
